{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"The input is copied into a fixed-size buffer and then wrapped as the request buffer for parsing.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"value"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":585,"var":"helper->if_modified_since.raw","code":"helper->if_modified_since.raw = HEADER(\"If-Modified-Since\");","note":"When the parser sees the If-Modified-Since header name, it stores a raw pointer/length pair into the helper without copying the value.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"header bytes"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1644,"var":"helper.if_modified_since.raw.value","code":"parse_if_modified_since(&helper);","note":"After request parsing succeeds, the helper field is re-parsed as a date string.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"stored header value"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_if_modified_since","line":616,"var":"helper->if_modified_since.raw.value","code":"if (UNLIKELY(lwan_parse_rfc_time(helper->if_modified_since.raw.value, &parsed) < 0)) return;","note":"The raw header value is passed directly to the RFC-time parser, so any malformed or boundary-length value reaches the sink path.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"pointer"}]},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan.h","function":"string_as_int32","line":136,"var":"i","code":"memcpy(&i, s, sizeof(int32_t));","note":"The parser's STRING_SWITCH macro expands to a 4-byte memcpy from the current pointer, which is the memory-safety sink for short inputs.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"macro expansion"}]},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-time.c","function":"lwan_parse_rfc_time","line":51,"var":"STRING_SWITCH(str)","code":"STRING_SWITCH(str) {","note":"The weekday check invokes the 4-byte load on attacker-controlled data before any length validation, matching the reported global-buffer-overflow READ.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"dereference"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace updated')
